_: Where a viewer who wants to join actually goes. The video says the links are in the description, so they have to be real before anything is published — autopost.mjs refuses to upload while groupUrl is empty. Not secret: this is the text viewers read.
_groupUrl: The Google Group that defines the closed test's tester list. Joining it first is mandatory — the opt-in link rejects anyone who is not a member. Only the Play Console owner has this URL. Override with YT_TESTER_GROUP_URL.
_optInUrl: Derived from packageId in store/android/twa-manifest.json. Play always serves the opt-in page at this path.
_contact: Optional. Shown as the fallback when the install fails. Leave empty to point at the comments instead.
